claims.citation: New York Herald, 17 August 1866, p. 8, col. 5
claims.verbatim:
Steamship Denmark (Br), Thompson, Liverpool Aug 1, via
Queenstown 2d inst, with mdse and 511 passengers, to Na-
tional Steam Navigation Co. Had strong westerly gales up
to the 11th inst, since light variable winds; 2d inst, passed
steamship Virginia, bound in; 3d, lat 51 10, lon 11 a steam-
ship, supposed the Persia, bound E; 8th, lat 47 55, lon 37
10, bark Merrimac, bound E; 9th, lat 47 10, lon 37 10, ship
Plymouth Rock and bark Josephine, bound E; 12th, lat 44
10, lon 50, bark E S McNeil, of Boston, bound E; same day,
Bremen bark Meridian, bound E; 14th, lat 41 37, lon 60 45,
steamship Helvetia, bound E.
